entries.speaker: Tall Man
entries.en: I told you, that drug is perfect![n]Deliver it, quick!

entries.speaker: Tall Man
entries.en: I've heard it's super effective. Even[n]the most barren deserts will become[n]lush forests of hair...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So that's who Ryuji was talking[n]about. Lush forests...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I don't really want to know. I guess[n]I can see how you'd mistake him for[n]what we want, though.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: We should forget about this guy...[n]Let's go look elsewhere.

entries.speaker: Kind Old Woman
entries.en: Hello, young man. Would you happen[n]to know how I could board the Inogami[n]Line?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Uhhh... Go down those stairs, then[n]turn left. Be careful, granny.

entries.speaker: Kind Old Woman
entries.en: Oh, Shibuya is so complicated.[n]These bones don't move like they[n]used to, either. How troubling.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Arghhh, c'mon...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh, [fName].

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Sorry, my lead didn't end up[n]bein' anything.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That dude at the stairs...[n]Pretty misleadin', huh?[n]Sheesh...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Oh, what about Ann and Yusuke?[n]You should go check on 'em.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, granny, you okay? You're lookin'[n]pretty shaky, so I don't mind givin' you[n]a hand.

entries.speaker: Kind Old Woman
entries.en: You have such stylish hair, young man.[n]And a kind personality as well.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Uh, thanks. I dunno what I'm even[n]doin' here though...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: He said his lead didn't amount[n]to anything. We should leave[n]this area to him, okay?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Come on, let's go see Lady Ann[n]and Yusuke.
